what: A V.90 DIL a digital modem sent downstream in answer to this Courier's Ja
format: G.711 A-law, 8 kHz, one octet per symbol, no header
shape: 197 segments x 66 symbols - N, LSP and LTP straight out of the descriptor
provenance: supplied by the user from their own capture; not produced by this repo

verified_against_the_rom.reference_slots: every TP=0 slot carries Ucode 0's level, magnitude 8
verified_against_the_rom.training_slots: each segment's 12 TP=1 slots hold one level, and it is the level of the Ucode this firmware generates for that segment
verified_against_the_rom.mapping: 117 distinct Ucodes to 117 distinct levels, one to one, no exceptions

law: A-law. Ucode 100 is 10496 here; mu-law would be 10364.
